name: Hokenshitsu no Megami ~Oppai Kyoushi Ikaho Hinoki no Himitsu~
original_name: 保健室の女神～おっぱい教師 伊香保桧の秘密～
source:
"Excuse me, miss. May I ask you about something?"

There's a goddess at my school.

Her name is Dr. Hinoko Ikaho.

She's utterly gorgeous. I don't know why she became a doctor when she could have been a famous gravure idol. But I'm glad she did. She makes the clinic feel sexy.

There's also a rumor about her.

I was naive and impressionable. I was seduced by the rumor, and tried it for myself.

It was an unbelievable experience. Oh, my goddess! Ms. Hinoki...!

translation:
“请问小姐，请问有什么事吗？”

我的学校有一位女神。

她的名字是伊香保日乃子博士。

她非常漂亮。我不知道她本来可以成为著名的凹版偶像，为什么却成为一名医生。但我很高兴她这么做了。她让诊所感觉很性感。

还有关于她的传闻。

我很天真，很容易受影响。我被谣言所诱惑，并亲自尝试了一下。

这是一次令人难以置信的经历。哦，我的女神！桧木小姐……！
